newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs must defeat 126.65 on way to 127.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs must defeat 126.65 on way to 127.00.

text.p: June BTP futures will attempt to defeat resistance at 126.65 from Friday's hourly charts in order to set their sights on 127.00, technical analysts said on Monday.
Analysts said the market was bouncing in reaction to Friday's spike down to 125.80, and had already taken out minor resistance at 126.30/35 in early trade.
"BTPs are poised on the brink of the 126.65 hourly resistance, but it may prove more of a stumbling block," said David Sneddon, technical analyst at Credit Suisse First Boston in London.
June BTPs were trading at 126.52, after reaching a high of 126.63 earlier in the session.
The 127.00 area was the next major target, where psychological resistance was backed up by Friday's high at 126.85, analysts said.
A technical analyst at a European bank said in a research note there could be room for a bounce, but good selling pressure could first emerge around 127.00.
Sneddon said the market would be sidelined, and forced to consolidate under 126.65 if it could not break through to test 127.00.
The 127.00 level was also a 38.2 percent Fibonacci retracement of the move from a low of 123.70 on April 1 to a high of 129.05 on April 15 and 17.
On the downside, analysts said it was key for the market to hold 125.74, a 61.8 percent retracement of the April upmove.
"A break of the 125.70 area, which is the spike lower, and the top of the whole base pattern could see 123.70 reached reasonably quickly," Sneddon said.
At the short end, June Eurolira futures were up five basis points at 93.06 by 0835 GMT.
